answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. The mean opinion score (MOS) subjectively measures speech naturalness (NMOS) and speaker similarity (SMOS)... For objective evaluations, a neural network-based system ... is used to measure speech quality (WV-MOS). Character error rate (CER) ... Speaker similarity (SSIM) is calculated by an SV model.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 120 testing pairs for subjective evaluations involving a group of 15 listeners. The mean opinion score (MOS) subjectively measures speech naturalness (NMOS) and speaker similarity (SMOS).
answer_4.guideline: Listeners rate each converted sample on naturalness and speaker similarity using a MOS scale.
